title: Asian-Style Red Cabbage Slaw
description: A quick, crunchy slaw with a tangy sesame-lime dressing — a light, low-fat side to cut through richer mains.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 300g shredded red cabbage and 100g shredded carrot.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp maple syrup, and 1 tbsp lime juice.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrot, and toss well to coat. Season with salt to taste.
Let sit for 5-10 minutes to soften slightly, then serve as a side.
notes: Nearly zero impact on fat or protein targets — mainly adds carbs from the cabbage, carrot, and maple syrup.
